note: Plain-English notes on Android Auto flags. Flag names, types and defaults are facts read from Android Auto and from the AA Experiments feature catalog; the wording here is this project's own. "verified" entries were checked on the stated version only.

flags.name: SystemUi__horizontal_rail_canonical_breakpoint_dp
flags.title: Rail position
flags.description: Cutoff that decides whether the app rail sits along the bottom of the screen or down the side.
flags.suggest: 40 or 2000 (default 450); which way each pushes the rail depends on the screen
flags.verified: Moves the rail on Android Auto 18.0.664264 (checked in DHU).

flags.name: SystemUi__widescreen_breakpoint_dp
flags.title: Widescreen width cutoff
flags.description: Minimum screen width for the widescreen layout (map with a side panel). Lower it to get widescreen on a narrower screen. The aspect-ratio cutoff has to allow it too.

flags.name: SystemUi__widescreen_aspect_ratio_breakpoint
flags.title: Widescreen aspect-ratio cutoff
flags.description: How wide the screen must be compared with its height to count as widescreen. An 800x480 screen is 1.667, just under the default.

flags.name: SystemUi__widescreen_aspect_ratio_breakpoint_for_portrait
flags.title: Widescreen aspect ratio, portrait path
flags.description: Same cutoff as above, used on the portrait layout path. Only relevant on tall screens.

flags.name: SystemUi__semi_widescreen_breakpoint_dp
flags.title: Semi-widescreen width cutoff
flags.description: Minimum width for the in-between "semi-widescreen" layout.

flags.name: SystemUi__portrait_breakpoint_dp
flags.title: Portrait layout cutoff
flags.description: Cutoff for choosing the portrait layout. Only matters on tall screens.

flags.name: SystemUi__short_portrait_breakpoint_dp
flags.title: Short-portrait cutoff
flags.description: Cutoff for the short portrait layout. Only matters on tall screens.

flags.name: SystemUi__narrow_portrait_width_threshold_dp
flags.title: Narrow-portrait width
flags.description: Width below which a tall screen is treated as narrow portrait.

flags.name: SystemUi__full_maps_and_dashboard_width_threshold_dp
flags.title: Map + dashboard width
flags.description: Width needed to show a full map together with the dashboard. Raising it above your screen width should switch that combined view off.

flags.name: SystemUi__wide_dashboard_min_map_height_dp
flags.title: Wide dashboard map height
flags.description: Minimum map height before the wide dashboard is allowed.

flags.name: SystemUi__vertical_rail_widget_enabled
flags.title: Rail widget
flags.description: Shows a small media or navigation card on the rail in more layouts, so the other app stays visible.

flags.name: SystemUi__vertical_rail_widget_enabled_all
flags.title: Rail widget, forced
flags.description: Stronger version of the rail widget switch. Try it only if the normal one does nothing.

flags.name: SystemUi__use_compose_rail
flags.title: Newer rail implementation
flags.description: Replaces the rail with its newer internal implementation. It may look identical or be less stable.

flags.name: SystemUi__edge_to_edge_maps_enabled
flags.title: Edge-to-edge maps
flags.description: Draws maps and eligible apps right to the screen edges.

flags.name: SystemUi__rhd_flip_enable
flags.title: Right-hand-drive layout
flags.description: The name suggests it mirrors the layout for right-hand-drive cars. What it actually changes is not confirmed.

flags.name: SystemUi__inertial_scrolling_enabled
flags.title: Smooth scrolling
flags.description: Lets lists scroll freely instead of jumping a page at a time.

flags.name: CarAppLibrary__tab_layout_orientation
flags.title: Tab direction inside apps
flags.description: Direction of tabs in apps built on the car app library: 0 horizontal, 1 vertical, 2 automatic.

flags.name: CieloFeature__cielo_status
flags.title: New interface (Cielo)
flags.description: Switches Android Auto to the redesigned interface Google is preparing, codenamed Cielo, following the phone's light/dark theme. It is unfinished, so expect missing screens. Only known value: system_theme.
flags.verified: On Android Auto 18.0.664264 this enables the new interface; the navigation app fills the screen.

flags.name: CieloFeature__cielo_rail_nav_model
flags.title: Cielo rail model
flags.description: Selects a different rail navigation model in the new interface. What each number means is not known.

flags.name: CieloFeature__use_draggable_dashboard
flags.title: Rearrangeable dashboard
flags.description: The name suggests a dashboard you can rearrange in the new interface. Not confirmed.

flags.name: CieloFeature__earth_enabled
flags.title: Widget dashboard (Earth)
flags.description: Main switch for the widget dashboard in the new interface. Reported to need a newer Android version (API 37) and head-unit support, so it may do nothing or crash.

flags.name: CieloFeature__earth_status
flags.title: Widget dashboard mode
flags.description: Selects the widget dashboard path. Only known value: CAR.SYS. Same requirements as the main switch.

flags.name: CieloFeature__earth_dashboard_widget_combo_enabled
flags.title: Dashboard + widgets
flags.description: Dashboard and widgets shown together. Depends on the widget dashboard being active.

flags.name: CieloFeature__earth_mini_dashboard_card_enabled
flags.title: Mini dashboard card
flags.description: A small dashboard card in the widget dashboard. Depends on the combined dashboard + widgets view.

flags.name: CieloFeature__earth_tilt
flags.title: Maximum widgets
flags.description: Despite the name, the maximum number of widgets that can be added to the widget dashboard.

flags.name: Coolwalk__use_light_dark_theme
flags.title: Light/dark theme
flags.description: Light and dark theme handling for the main interface. New in 18.0; the visible effect is not guaranteed.

flags.name: Coolwalk__neutralized_theme_kill_switch
flags.title: Wallpaper-derived colours
flags.description: true keeps the fixed colour palette; false lets colours be derived from the wallpaper.

flags.name: Coolwalk__palette_base_color
flags.title: Accent colour
flags.description: Base colour the interface palette is built from, as a hex colour.

flags.name: IndependentNightModeFeature__enabled
flags.title: Independent night mode
flags.description: Day/night mode for the car screen that does not follow the phone.

flags.name: SystemUi__twin_smarts_mode
flags.title: Animated notification cards
flags.description: Animated shader effect on notification cards. Only the exact value 13007 switches it on.

flags.name: Assistant__icon_experiment_variant
flags.title: Assistant button icon
flags.description: Icon on the assistant button: 0 classic microphone, 1 Gemini microphone, 2 Gemini spark, 3 Gemini 2026 logo.

flags.name: Coolwalk__nav_app_border_width
flags.title: Navigation window border
flags.description: Width of a border drawn around the navigation window.

flags.name: SystemUi__wallpaper_backdrop_enabled
flags.title: Wallpaper behind the interface
flags.description: Draws the wallpaper behind the interface.

flags.name: PhoneThemeFeature__enable_dynamic_font_family
flags.title: Phone-maker font
flags.description: Uses the phone manufacturer's font in the car interface where one is defined.

flags.name: SystemUi__status_bar_theme_overlay_kill_switch
flags.title: Status bar theme overlay
flags.description: true applies the light/dark overlay to the status area of the rail; false uses the plain version.

flags.name: ApolloFeature__expressive_enabled
flags.title: Expressive media player
flags.description: The "expressive" media design, including the wavy progress bar. Force it to false for the plain bar. Other parts of the player look may change with it.
flags.suggest: false to remove the wavy bar
flags.verified: false removes the wavy progress bar on Android Auto 18.0.664264.

flags.name: HeroFeature__use_new_media_ui
flags.title: New media player
flags.description: Main switch for the new media player. Forcing false brings back the previous player as a whole.

flags.name: SystemUi__project_accordion_enable
flags.title: Compact media layout
flags.description: A more compact, responsive media layout intended for smaller screens.

flags.name: Media__update_playback_background
flags.title: Album-art colours
flags.description: Player background and colours change with the album art.

flags.name: Media__force_skip_10s_media_actions_enabled
flags.title: ±10 second buttons
flags.description: Adds skip back/forward 10 seconds buttons when the app supports seeking.

flags.name: Media__support_multiple_dashboard_media_cards
flags.title: Several media cards
flags.description: Allows more than one media card on the dashboard.

flags.name: Media__show_album_art_for_suggestion
flags.title: Album art on suggestions
flags.description: Shows album art on media suggestions.

flags.name: Media__query_media_app_directly_for_suggestions_enabled
flags.title: Suggestions from the app
flags.description: Asks the media app itself for suggestions.

flags.name: Media__display_disable_autoplay_notification_enabled
flags.title: Autoplay hint popup
flags.description: The popup that suggests turning autoplay off after you pause several times.

flags.name: CarAppLibrary__miniplayer_overlay_enabled
flags.title: Mini-player overlay
flags.description: An expandable mini-player shown inside other apps.

flags.name: CarAppLibrary__enable_progress_buttons_on_dashboard_mode
flags.title: Progress on dashboard buttons
flags.description: Dashboard action buttons that show real progress.

flags.name: HeroFeature__force_hero_layout
flags.title: Force large media layout
flags.description: Forces the large media layout. Reported to scale badly and crash on low-resolution screens.

flags.name: SystemUi__media_hun_timeout_ms
flags.title: Now-playing popup time
flags.description: How long the "now playing" popup stays on screen, in milliseconds.

flags.name: Assistant__asr_1_75_leave_media_on_during_voice_session
flags.title: Music during voice
flags.description: Keeps media playing while you talk to the assistant, on one of the voice paths.

flags.name: SystemUi__display_bell_when_status_elements_hidden
flags.title: Keep notification bell
flags.description: Keeps the notification-centre bell visible when other status icons are hidden.

flags.name: SystemUi__quick_settings_enabled
flags.title: Quick settings
flags.description: Adds theme, battery saver, do-not-disturb and settings shortcuts to the notification centre. You need the bell visible to reach it.

flags.name: Coolwalk__dashboard_show_3p_notifications_with_actions_enabled
flags.title: App notifications with buttons
flags.description: Allows third-party notifications with action buttons on the dashboard.

flags.name: SystemUi__hun_default_heads_up_timeout_ms
flags.title: Popup time
flags.description: How long a notification popup stays on screen, in milliseconds.

flags.name: SystemUi__media_hun_in_rail_widget_timeout_ms
flags.title: Rail popup time
flags.description: How long a media notification stays in the rail widget, in milliseconds.

flags.name: SystemUi__dnd_suppress_notifications_enabled
flags.title: Follow Do Not Disturb
flags.description: When the phone is in Do Not Disturb, popups and their sounds are suppressed in the car.

flags.name: SystemUi__stack_hun_buttons_if_actions_contain_text_enabled
flags.title: Stacked popup buttons
flags.description: Stacks popup buttons vertically when they have text labels.

flags.name: Dialer__enable_third_action_on_call_huns
flags.title: Third button on call popup
flags.description: Allows a third button on incoming-call popups.

flags.name: HeadUnitFeature__show_update_notifications_enabled
flags.title: Head-unit update notices
flags.description: Notices about known software updates for the car's head unit.

flags.name: Messaging__display_hun_only_for_notification_importance_above_default
flags.title: Popups only for important messages
flags.description: When true, only notifications set to pop up on the phone get a popup in the car. Forcing false should let more through.

flags.name: Messaging__autoplay_messages_kill_switch
flags.title: Read messages aloud automatically
flags.description: Allows incoming messages to be read out automatically. Other settings still apply.

flags.name: Messaging__cal_mute_button_enabled
flags.title: Mute button on conversations
flags.description: Adds mute/unmute to conversations.

flags.name: Messaging__smart_action_navigate_enabled_for_all_nav_apps
flags.title: Navigate action for all nav apps
flags.description: Offers the "navigate" smart action with more navigation apps.

flags.name: Messaging__image_description_readout_enabled
flags.title: Describe images
flags.description: Lets the assistant describe images in messages.

flags.name: Coolwalk__assistant_suggestions_enabled
flags.title: Assistant suggestions
flags.description: Assistant suggestion chips on the home screen.

flags.name: Assistant__gemini_luminous_ui_updates
flags.title: Gemini voice UI
flags.description: Experimental Gemini voice interface.

flags.name: AceFeature__actionable_insight_enabled
flags.title: Actionable insights
flags.description: Turns contextual insights into suggestions you can act on.

flags.name: Assistant__transcription_character_limit
flags.title: Transcription length
flags.description: Maximum number of characters shown when the assistant transcribes what you say.

flags.name: SystemUi__use_cal_voice_plate_for_gemini
flags.title: Newer Gemini voice panel
flags.description: Uses the newer voice panel for Gemini.

flags.name: UserEducation__assistant_tooltip_nth_run_button_enabled
flags.title: Assistant hint bubbles
flags.description: Hint bubbles that teach assistant features.

flags.name: Csat__assistant_csat_enabled
flags.title: Assistant satisfaction prompts
flags.description: "How was the assistant?" prompts.

flags.name: Assistant__quick_feedback_triggering_rate
flags.title: Assistant feedback rate
flags.description: How often a quick feedback prompt appears after using the assistant, as a fraction.

flags.name: Dialer__quick_feedback_display_rate
flags.title: Call feedback rate
flags.description: How often a quick feedback prompt appears after calls, as a fraction.

flags.name: Watevra__primary_actions_on_coolwalk
flags.title: Main action next to arrival time
flags.description: Puts a navigation app's main action button next to the arrival estimate.

flags.name: CarAppLibrary__allow_tall_narrow_for_nav_apps
flags.title: Tall/narrow navigation layout
flags.description: Lets navigation apps use a tall, narrow layout.

flags.name: Watevra__disable_alphajump
flags.title: Hide A-Z jump
flags.description: The name suggests it removes the A-Z jump button in long lists. Not confirmed.

flags.name: VideoEncoderParams__max_qp_wireless
flags.title: Wireless picture quality (max QP)
flags.description: Upper limit of video compression over Wi-Fi. Lower means a sharper picture and more data; go back if the picture stutters.

flags.name: VideoEncoderParams__min_qp_wireless
flags.title: Wireless picture quality (min QP)
flags.description: Lower limit of video compression over Wi-Fi.

flags.name: AudioBufferingFeature__default_minimum_audio_buffers_for_wifi
flags.title: Wi-Fi audio buffering
flags.description: Minimum audio buffering over Wi-Fi. More buffering can fix crackling but adds delay.

flags.name: WirelessProjectionInGearhead__start_from_notification_enabled
flags.title: Start wireless from a notification
flags.description: A phone notification you can tap to start wireless Android Auto.

flags.name: WirelessProjectionInGearhead__enable_dual_sta
flags.title: Keep normal Wi-Fi
flags.description: Asks for a second Wi-Fi connection so the phone keeps its normal Wi-Fi while connected to the car. Depends on the phone.

flags.name: WirelessProjectionInGearhead__wifi_lock_selected_option_in_network_request_manager
flags.title: Wi-Fi lock mode
flags.description: Wi-Fi lock used during projection: no_lock, low_latency or high_performance. Any other text can crash Android Auto.

flags.name: WirelessProjectionInGearhead__dongle_device_name_matches
flags.title: Wireless adapter names
flags.description: Comma-separated Bluetooth name fragments Android Auto uses to recognise wireless adapters.

flags.name: BluetoothPairing__prevent_rebonding_during_wireless_projection
flags.title: Stop re-pairing
flags.description: Stops automatic Bluetooth re-pairing during a wireless session.

flags.name: FrameRateRestrictions__fps_limit_for_restriction_level_medium
flags.title: Frame cap when warm
flags.description: Frame-rate limit applied when the phone is moderately warm.

flags.name: CradleFeature__all_app_launcher_enabled
flags.title: Phone Apps tab
flags.description: Adds a "Phone Apps" tab to the launcher for use while parked. May depend on Android version and head unit.

flags.name: CradleFeature__allow_video_apps
flags.title: Video apps while parked
flags.description: Makes video apps eligible for parked mode. May depend on Android version and head unit.

flags.name: CradleFeature__show_dpi_picker
flags.title: Density picker for phone apps
flags.description: Lets you choose the display density for projected phone apps.

flags.name: TouchpadUiNavigation__base_fraction
flags.title: Touchpad movement base
flags.description: Base value used to work out how far a touchpad movement must travel to count.

flags.name: TouchpadUiNavigation__min_size_mm
flags.title: Touchpad minimum movement
flags.description: Smallest physical movement, in millimetres, that counts as a step.

flags.name: TouchpadUiNavigation__multimove_penalty_mm
flags.title: Touchpad multi-move penalty
flags.description: Extra distance required when several moves are recognised in a row.

flags.name: TouchpadUiNavigation__tuning_enabled
flags.title: Touchpad tuning
flags.description: The name suggests it enables the tuning values above. Not confirmed.

flags.name: ContentBrowse__enable_speed_bump_projected
flags.title: List limiter type
flags.description: Chooses the limiter for list browsing while moving: true is the rate-based SpeedBump, false the older tap counter. It switches between them; it does not remove limiting. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: Watevra__speedbump_enabled
flags.title: App limiter type
flags.description: Same choice of limiter for apps built on the car app library. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: Media__projected_speedbump_enabled
flags.title: Media limiter
flags.description: Rate-based limiter for media browsing while moving. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: ContentBrowse__drawer_default_allowed_taps_touchpad
flags.title: Tap budget (touchpad/knob)
flags.description: How many steps you may take in a list with a touchpad or knob before browsing pauses, under the tap-counter limiter. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: Watevra__speedbump_map_interactivity_enabled
flags.title: Map interaction rules
flags.description: Changes the rules for tapping, panning and zooming maps while moving. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: CarAppLibrary__conversation_item_max_message_lines_while_driving
flags.title: Message lines while driving
flags.description: How many lines of a message are shown while moving. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: ContentBrowse__sixtap_force_enabled
flags.title: Tap counter while parked
flags.description: Keeps the tap counter active even when parked. Useful only for testing.

flags.name: ContentBrowse__speedbump_force_enabled
flags.title: SpeedBump while parked
flags.description: Keeps the rate-based limiter active even when parked. Handy for seeing it in DHU.

flags.name: ContentBrowse__keyboard_force_disabled
flags.title: Force keyboard off
flags.description: Forces the on-screen keyboard off as if driving.

flags.name: StratoFeature__ignore_input_restrictions
flags.title: Bypass input restrictions
flags.description: Bypasses part of the input restrictions on one internal path. How much it covers is not known. This is a driving-safety limit; change it with care.

flags.name: DeveloperOverrides__force_lite_mode
flags.title: Lite mode
flags.description: The name suggests a reduced "lite" mode. Effect not confirmed.

flags.name: Performance__pre_warm_activities_enabled
flags.title: Preload screens
flags.description: Preloads screens for faster switching. May not be noticeable.
